 Nandini Layout,

JUDGMENT
The P.S.I., of Peenya Police Station, Bengaluru has filed the charge sheet against the accused for the offences punishable under Sections 120(B) and 392 r/w. Section 34 of IPC.

2. The learned Magistrate after complying with the provisions under Section 207 Cr.P.C., has committed the case against the accused No.5 under Section 209 of Cr.P.C., by splitting up the case against the accused Nos.1 to 4 to the Court of Hon'ble Prl. City Civil & Sessions Judge, Bengaluru, as the offences under Section 392 of IPC is exclusively triable by the Court of Sessions.

sentences.text: After committal of the case, the case is made over to this court for trial in accordance with law.

3. The brief facts of the prosecution case are as under:
That on 6.06.2011 at about 12-50 a.m., while C.W.1 was going in his TATA Indica Car Peenya P S vs A5 Syed Khazar on 4 October, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/55967732/
1 bearing No.KA-41-3432 near Goraguntepalya after having tea, the accused Nos.1 to 5 have criminally conspired to commit the crime, have alighted the car of C.W.1 on the pretext of asking for a drop saying that the relative of accused Nos.1 and 2 had died and asked C.W.1 to give them drop near 8th Mile.

sentences.text: When C.W.1 was driving his car near Shell Petrol Bunk, situated at N.H.4, 8th Mile, within the limits of Peenya Police Station, Bengaluru, the accused No.2 by showing a machu, pulled C.W.1 out of the car and robbed the car of C.W.1 and fled away from the spot.

Thereby the accused are alleged to have committed the offences punishable under Sections 120(B) and 397 r/w. Section 34 of IPC.
4.
On securing the presence of the accused No.5 under body warrant, the charge has been framed against him for the offences punishable under Sections 120(B) and 397 r/w. Section 34 of IPC.
The accused No.5 has pleaded not guilty and claimed to be tried.
Thereafter, the prosecution in support of its case has examined 3 witnesses as P.Ws.1 to 3 and got marked 2 documents as Exs.P.1 and 2.
After closure of the evidence of prosecution witnesses, the statement of accused under Section 313 of Cr.P.C., was recorded.
The accused No.5 has denied the incriminating evidence against him.
The accused No.5 has chosen not to adduce any evidence on his behalf.
5. Heard the arguments.

6. The points raised for determination are as under :
1. Whether the prosecution proves beyond all reasonable doubt that on 6.06.2021 at about 12-50 a.m., near Shell Petrol Bunk situated at N.H.4 Road, 8th Mile, within the limits of Peenya Police Station, Bengaluru, the accused No.5 along with split-up accused Nos.1 to 4 in furtherance of their common intention to commit dacoity have alighted the car of C.W.1 on the pretext of asking drop as the relative of accused Nos.1 and 2 had died and then the accused No.2 by showing machu towards C.W.1 and pulled him out of the car and robbed the car of C.W.1 and fled away from the spot and thereby committed an offence punishable under Section 397 r/w. Section 34 of IPC ?
2. Whether the prosecution has proves beyond all reasonable doubt that the accused No.5 along with split-up accused Nos.1 to 4 with common intention to commit the crime have criminally conspired to commit dacoity and thereby committed an offence punishable under Section 120(B) r/w. Section 34 of IPC ?
3. What Order ?
7. My findings on the above points are as under :
POINT No.1 - Negative, POINT No.2 - Negative, POINT No.3 - As per final order, for the following :

sentences.text: POINTS Nos.1 & 2 : Since both these points are interconnected to each other, they have been taken up together for discussion in order to avoid the repetition of facts.

9. The case of the prosecution is that on 6.06.2011 at about 12-50 a.m., while C.W.1 was going in his TATA Indica Car bearing No.KA-41-3432 near Goraguntepalya after having tea, the accused Nos.1 to 5 have criminally conspired to commit the crime, have alighted the car of C.W.1 on the pretext of asking for a drop saying that the relative of accused Nos.1 and 2 had died and asked C.W.1 to give them drop near 8th Mile.

When C.W.1 was driving his car near Shell Petrol Bunk, situated at N.H.4,
8th Mile, within the limits of Peenya Police Station, Bengaluru
, the accused No.2 by showing a machu, pulled C.W.1 out of the car and robbed the car of C.W.1 and fled away from the spot.

Thereby the accused are alleged to have committed the offences punishable under Sections 120(B) and 397 r/w. Section 34 of IPC.
10.
P.W.1-Sri.Ranganath, A.S.I., has stated that on 6.07.2011 at 5-30 a.m., C.W.15 called them to his house at 8th Mile, so they immediately went to 8 th Mile.
On reaching the spot C.W.15 showed them a suspicious car and asked them to follow the car.
In the car there were 2 people and one of them got down from the car and escaped on noticing that the car was being followed.
Thereafter they caught hold of other person who is the accused No.1 in this case.
The car was TATA Indica bearing No.KA-41-3432 and it was mentioned in Crime No.376/2011.
He then took the accused No.1 along with the vehicle to the Police Station and he has given a statement to the Investigating Officer.
He has identified the accused.
11. P.W.2-Sri.B.N.Shamanna, Retired Dy.S.P., has stated that on 6.07.2011 between 9-00 to 9-45 a.m., he conducted the spot mahazar (Ex.P.1) in the presence of panchas (C.Ws.2 and 3).
He then received the RC Book and Insurance of the car from C.W.1.
He deputed C.Ws.7, 8 and 15 to trace other accused.
On the same day at 11-00 a.m., accused No.2 was produced before him.
At 12-30 p.m., accused Nos.3 to 5 were produced before him and in this regard C.W.15 gave a report (Ex.P.2).
He recorded the statements of C.Ws.6 to 10 and further statement of C.W.1.
He produced all the accused before the court and on completion of investigation, he filed the charge sheet against the accused.
He has identified the accused who appeared before the court through VC.
In his cross examination by the learned advocate for the accused, he has denied the suggestion that he has not carried out any investigation in this case.
He has denied the suggestion that the accused were not produced before him and he has not recorded their voluntary statements.
He has denied the suggestion that the accused who appeared through VC have nothing to do with this case.
He has denied the suggestion that he is deposing falsely before the court.
Theerthaprasad, A.S.I., has stated that on 7.07.2011 at 11-00 a.m., he along with C.W.15 apprehended the accused Nos.1 to 5 and produced them in the Police Station,
In this regard C.W.15 has given his report.
He has identified the accused.
In his cross examination by the learned advocate for the accused, it is elicited that the photo and description of the accused were not given to them.

He has denied the suggestion that they went and apprehended the accused in their house and brought them to the Police Station and falsely Peenya P S vs A5 Syed Khazar on 4 October, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/55967732/
3 implicated them in this case.
13.

sentences.text: On considering the oral and documentary evidence placed before the court, it is pertinent to note that in this case even after issuance of proclamation, the presence of C.W.1 could not be secured and hence he was dropped.
There is no evidence before the court to corroborate the manner in which the alleged incident had taken place.
Even otherwise there is no corroborative evidence regarding recovery from the possession of the accused.

As such in the absence of cogent, corroborative and convincing evidence, it can be safely said that the prosecution has failed to prove beyond all reasonable doubt that the accused No.5 has committed the offences punishable under Sections 120(B) and 397 r/w. Section 34 of IPC.
Hence, I answer the Point Nos.1 and 2 in the Negative.
14. POINT No.3:

In view of my findings on Point Nos.1 and 2 as above, I proceed to pass the following :
ORDER
Acting under Section 235(1) of Cr.P.C. accused No.5 is acquitted for the offences punishable under Sections 120(B) and 397 r/w. Section 34 of IPC.
The accused No.5 is set at liberty forthwith, if he is not required in any other case.
(Dictated to the Stenographer Grade-II directly on Computer, corrected, signed and then pronounced by me in the open court on this the 4 th day of October 2025)
(RASHMI.M) LXVII Addl.City Civil & Sessions Judge, Bengaluru.
